skill.name: Commit/Attack
skill.strategic_description: Attack/commit corresponds to the enemy initiating fire, producing an enemy volley while the player ship remains present; other listed changes are mostly object-ID remappings of HUD/background elements.

steps: Observe whether the opposing side is actively engaging now

Execute the action that triggers the hostile exchange
Confirm engagement occurred while own agent remains present

contract.name: Fire on Target
contract.description: Press fire when your ship is lined up with an enemy pair in the playfield to shoot them before they pass or attack. Use this during normal waves whenever enemies are directly ahead and within range.
